name: Lifesaving Lincoln Laboratory device wins 2026 Excellence in Technology Transfer Award
summary: The handheld catheterization device AI-GUIDE, created by Lincoln Laboratory and Massachusetts General Hospital, promises improved health outcomes for injured service members and civilians.
